title: Scalable Optimal Online Auctions
authors: Dominic Coey; Bradley Larsen; Kane Sweeney; Caio Waisman
eligible_reason: Methods paper on computing optimal reserve prices for online auctions: Monte Carlo simulations and an application to eBay iPhone auctions (bid distributions). No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: simulations.m, myerson_simulations.m, plot_iso_data_curve.m (figures) and ebay_application.m (estimation on auction-level highest and second-highest bids); plot_bar_charts.do only draws Figure 5. Regression inventory empty.
data_files_note: iphones.csv is governed by an eBay Data Use Agreement and is not shipped; only product names are included.
data_provenance_note: eBay auction data available only via eBay Data Council DUA.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
